## Before opening this

Please check [docs/phases/post-v1.md](../../docs/phases/post-v1.md) — it lists what is
already planned and what has been deliberately excluded, with reasons. If your idea is
there, add a comment on why it matters to you instead of opening a new issue.

Note that social features, ads, analytics, accounts, and anything requiring a network
connection to function are permanently excluded. See
[docs/00-brief.md §6](../../docs/00-brief.md).
